target_customer: AI agent builders and B2B go-to-market teams needing people, company, web and social data
problem: Agents and GTM teams stitch together many data providers. The Hog offers one pay-per-call API for web, people, company and social intelligence.
business_model: Usage-based API with credits and a free tier of 500 calls per month per a third-party profile
product_category: Web intelligence API and AI go-to-market tooling

founders.name: Hudson Liao
founders.background_notes: YC page lists about 15 years in go-to-market and claims he scaled one startup from roughly 900K to 7M ARR in three months. No employers or education named.

competitors.name: Exa
competitors.what: Web search API built for AI
competitors.traction_then: Reported annualized revenue of about 10M by September 2025

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating and normalizing several data providers behind one API with waterfall routing is standard integration work, with scraping and reliability as the harder parts.

defensibility.rationale: Reseller and aggregator model with no stated proprietary data, facing funded rivals such as Exa and Tavily.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded web data APIs for agents already existed. Later reports show Exa raising a 250M Series C in 2026. No source shows any move against The Hog specifically.

market_need_then: Agent builders needed live web and people data in 2025, shown by funding into Exa, Tavily and Firecrawl. Evidence for The Hog's own demand is not found.

branding.domain_note: Uses thehog.ai with the article, since the.hog variants were not used. No source on acquisition.

identity.logo: not described by any source found

brand_strength.rationale: A quirky animal word that is easy to remember, but search is dominated by PostHog's hedgehog mascot and other hog results. No brand press found.

outcome_analysis: The Hog is a two person Fall 2025 YC company selling a data API to agents and GTM teams. Positioning shifts between a web intelligence API and an AI demand generation command center across sources. No funding, traction, acquisition or shutdown is verified, so the outcome cannot yet be judged.
notes: The company website thehog.ai could not be fetched because the safety check was rate limited, so site content is not used. Funding is unverified: StartupHub says $500K total, another profile says a 130K seed in 2025-09. Both are aggregators and conflict, so no round is recorded. Paulo Nascimento is named as cofounder only by aggregators, not by the YC page, so he is not listed. The 9M General Catalyst round is Context.dev, a different company.
